style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh cool sun-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice blue #BFE0F0, violet-periwinkle gradient base #99A5DE, charcoal-navy text #3A3F5C and one periwinkle accent #6B7FD7, with blush pink #F2AFC4 reserved as a color-block surface for packaging and closing shots; cool bright studio lighting with soft directional keys and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-navy or white; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright can silhouette and scale across the set, hero can shown full and uncut, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins

style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-navy #3A3F5C or white #FFFFFF, all copy wrapped in 「」; periwinkle accent #6B7FD7 reserved for thin-line icons and small badges; blush pink #F2AFC4 kept as a color-block surface only, never as a text color
